name: DisciplinarySanctionsCaseManager
tagline: Cards, suspensions, hearings, appeals and fines – the whole disciplinary office in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete disciplinary case manager for leagues, county associations and clubs: referee reports and cards become cases, the offence tariff pre-fills sanctions, cautions accumulate into automatic suspensions, every served match and fine payment is tracked, hearings and appeal windows are managed, and a team-sheet eligibility check shows who is still suspended. Works in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data the moment it is dropped.
features: Workflow Reported → Under review → Charged → Hearing → Sanctioned → Appealed → Closed with enforced transitions
Configurable offence tariff pre-fills suspensions and fines
Caution accumulation thresholds with automatic suspension and at-risk alerts
Served-match tracking and team-sheet eligibility check
Hearing calendar with notice check and outcome-due flags
Appeal windows, lodge appeal and dismissed / reduced / upheld decisions
Fines with due dates, part payments, bulk mark paid and club summary
Kanban board with drag & drop and keyboard Move to…
Bulk status changes, CSV export, undo, search, filters, sort and group
25 Power Fx outputs incl. SuspendedPlayersJson and 6 events
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
